prints Isha at the middle of the night on the nights without 16°, the same minute as its Fajr and the end of eating; absorbing it would put everyone's Isha at the middle of the night in June and July, where the Isha window would be empty (as the UK's midnight-Isha calendars, ruling R75)
six late-winter days a minute after Diyanet's Maghrib, the latest member's: Mawaqit's own Diyanet computation

prints Maghrib at sunset + 8 to + 8.6 all year, an offset of its own beyond Diyanet's + 7, which is the cap (the members' Maghribs spread past 2 min with the late-dawn member's + 4 among them, so spec 3.6 caps Maghrib at Diyanet's own, the most followed and the latest): one calendar; absorbing it would move everyone's Maghrib 2 min later

the threshold night (the class of ruling R72): on the night 16° is last reached before the summer or first reached after it, VIKZ's Isha, 16° + 10 min, lies at the sun's lowest point plus ten, and the next end of eating, the middle of the night (the 18° family's), at or before it, so Isha has no end that night (ruling R26): one night a year at a calendar, by up to 7 min
